purpose: Package the exact frozen Study-C final occurrence artifact ZIP bytes together with the frozen binding receipt for transport to the already-bound local Study-C executor without changing or reserializing the inner artifact.
package_contract: read artifact_id and artifact_digest only from the prospectively generated frozen binding
download the original GitHub artifact ZIP bytes by exact artifact_id
require SHA-256 of downloaded ZIP bytes to equal binding.artifact_digest
require binding workflow_run_id and workflow_head_sha to equal the frozen source run
copy the binding and readiness receipt byte-for-byte; do not rewrite them
upload the original final artifact ZIP as a file inside the outer handoff artifact; do not extract, recompress, or reserialize the inner final artifact
